final: WITH playlist_counts AS (SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(track_count) as avg_count FROM playlist_counts) SELECT pc.PlaylistId, pc.track_count, CAST(pc.track_count AS FLOAT) / ac.avg_count as ratio FROM playlist_counts pc CROSS JOIN average_count ac ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
